description:
Announcement, not a solicitation:

The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), U.S. Forest Service (FS), Intermountain Zone, Caribou-Targhee National Forest, intends to award from a BPA:

38ea bear resistant, 4 cu yard, dumpsters that have been certified and approved by the International Grizzly Bear Committee. Only dumpsters that have been certified and approved by the International Grizzly Bear Committee will be accepted.

Delivery is required to Saint Anthony Work Center,  499 N 2400 E (Teton Hwy), ST ANTHONY ID 83445
